label: sprite-suite-downpour
mode: Actual FightEngine with native Canvas; not browser screenshots

visualFindings.orientation: Both fighters face each other in both slot orders. Anne aims the pistol toward the opponent; Juggernaut presents a lateral fighting guard.
visualFindings.exterior: Both complete silhouettes, all feet, hands and the pistol stay within the viewport. No clipping observed.
visualFindings.alpha: Scene remains visible around the silhouettes. No opaque grey rectangle or conspicuous grey halo around Anne at gameplay scale. Juggernaut has bright skin highlights, without a background rectangle.
visualFindings.feet: Both soles/feet align with the rendered ground/shadow area. Visible-envelope offsets are 1.5064 px below ground for Anne and 0.2266 px for Juggernaut, unchanged after slot reversal; no material anchoring correction warranted.
visualFindings.selectionIsolation: Machine draw tracing confirms combat uses only the new combat PNGs while four portrait renders retain the existing selection paths.
visualFindings.scale: Anne is visibly smaller than the Juggernaut in accordance with the engine render. No visual mismatch requiring a registry calibration was found.

limits: Only static idle and intro/pause paths were exercised; no source animation, attack/collision fidelity or 1:1 fidelity is certified.
Left-facing appearance is the engine mirror, not a separately sourced opposite-side asset.
Browser DOM, CSS, input, decoding and service worker were not tested.
The in-memory Sharp normalization was lossless; original PNG files were not altered.
